verdict.rationale: Rainforest's own docs cover in-person acceptance on the same platform: a 'Process payments with a device' guide alongside online payments, and a Tap to Phone SDK for contactless acceptance on compatible devices. Merchant deposits and embedded reporting are documented at the merchant level, which implies in-person volume lands in the same balances and reports, but no source states this outright. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that device and tap-to-phone payments settle into the same merchant balances, deposits and reporting as online payins; detail on supported terminal hardware; independent or hands-on corroboration.
